A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PRG research. Their text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison, including matching material moved between the main text and supplement.

before.justification: v2 reports original PRG classification, corruption robustness, transfer-learning and ablation results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original PRG experiments and results, including the pretraining ablation relocated to Appendix A.1.1.

M1.justification: The GVP, ICFM and OTCFM variants, generative pretraining, reversed ODE feature extraction, classifier and joint fine-tuning objectives remain unchanged. The added Appendix A explanation does not specify a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain CIFAR-10, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet, their reported corruption evaluations, Swiss-roll illustrations, transfer learning and the dual-task experiment. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator memberships remain unchanged in the classification, corruption and transfer comparisons in Tables 3–7 and Appendix C.3. This includes the same generative, discriminative, self-supervised and robustness baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain the stated training budgets, optimizers, resolutions, batch sizes and solver settings. The 600-epoch control without pretraining is retained unchanged in its new appendix location.

E4.justification: The pretraining ablation in v2 Section 4.5.1 and Table 8 moves intact to v3 Appendix A.1.1 and supplementary Table 1. Other sensitivity studies, robustness evaluations and visual case studies are retained without new analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports run or seed counts, confidence intervals or formal significance tests for the experimental comparisons. Point-estimate reporting and the existing Hutchinson trace estimator remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical and graphical results are unchanged, including Table 5's 78.13% ImageNet accuracy for PRG-OTCFM-XL and Table 7's 98.72%/78.33% transfer accuracies. The relocated pretraining ablation also retains every value.

T1.justification: The mutual-information and KL derivations, ODE likelihood calculations, invertibility and manifold assumptions, and appendix formulas are retained. The new Appendix A paragraph provides informal interpretation without adding a formal result or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about model-agnostic representation learning, generative pretraining, classification performance, robustness and transferability. The added code statement does not alter these scientific claims.

C2.justification: Appendix A adds an explanation attributing raw-image baseline weaknesses to shortcut learning and attributing PRG's semantic representations and robustness to iterative ODE outputs and noise perturbations. These are new mechanism interpretations without additional validating experiments; existing limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a code-availability statement and repository link in the abstract, absent from v2. Appendix B's hyperparameters, hardware and timing disclosures remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the added access information, not the repository's contents or functionality.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 73 works and retain their positioning relative to generative classifiers, denoising autoencoders and internal-layer feature extraction. Bibliographic differences concern citation-page references rather than research coverage.

P1.justification: v3 adds an introductory quotation, acknowledgments and supplementary contents, updates author affiliations, expands Appendix A and relocates the pretraining ablation there. These are limited organizational and prose edits; most narrative remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Existing displays are repositioned and renumbered: Figure 6 moves within page 6, Table 6 shifts to page 8, and the pretraining table moves into the supplement. The supplementary heading and contents introduce reflow, while figure content and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves access and navigation through the code-availability statement, supplementary contents and placement of the pretraining ablation beside its explanation. All experimental evidence and technical details are retained. The new shortcut-learning and robustness explanation lacks additional mechanism-specific validation, so the gains are limited to documentation and organization.
